parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for pure ESM .mjs output, exact argparse behavior, Python string repr, splitlines/unified diff behavior, and zero npm dependencies by writing a detailed SPEC.md for children.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept global orchestration and final integration while assigning pyrepr, difflib, and argparse modules to three child agents; no child was assigned the final test1.mjs entry or deepdiff integration.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote /output/lib/pyrepr.mjs, /output/lib/difflib.mjs, and /output/lib/argparse.mjs, but difflib and pyrepr verification remained unsettled and no DeepDiff wrapper or entry point was produced.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent never resumed after the AgentSwarm call to inspect child outputs or assemble imports; artifact validation copied only the three library files and marked expected test1.mjs missing.
parallel.verification: Module-level harnesses ran inside children, including a 90/90 argparse matrix, a 348/353 pyrepr sweep, and difflib checks still running; there was no parent-run integrated check of node /output/test1.mjs.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: All children were reported aborted, the parent turn was cancelled, test1.mjs and deepdiff.mjs were absent, artifact_ok was false, and the official evaluator passed 0 of 70 samples.

serial.requirements: The serial actor independently recognized the same ESM, argument parsing, DeepDiff output, string repr, splitlines, and no-dependency requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned behavior probing, module writing, integration, entry-point assembly, and verification without handoff boundaries or child joins.
serial.implementation: It wrote pystr, sequencematcher, difflib, deepdiff, argparse, and the /output/test1.mjs entry, giving the evaluator a coherent module stack and executable entry.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contained test1.mjs plus all library files and passed artifact validation before official evaluation.
serial.verification: The serial run launched a large differential fuzzer that timed out, then confirmed 10 argparse edge cases and 15 quick DeepDiff comparisons against the executable before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out before a final response and still failed three official samples, but it remained evaluable and passed 67 of 70 tests.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exceeded the process budget, but parallel spent closure inside a pending swarm; serial reached a deliverable state before timeout.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail because the current completed status evaluations mark solution_passed false for both modes. The practical quality gap is concrete: parallel delivered no test1.mjs entry and scored 0/70, while serial delivered a runnable ESM entry and supporting libraries and scored 67/70. The retained parallel coordination pattern explains why the parallel artifact never reached the same assembled surface, but it is not a pass/fail outcome differential because the serial run also failed the all-tests criterion.
parallel_contributors: Parent delegated component modules to a blocking AgentSwarm and never returned to assemble /output/test1.mjs or DeepDiff integration.
Child work remained partial or unreturned at cancellation, leaving only three library files in the final artifact.
serial_contributors: Single actor wrote the final entry file and all supporting modules before timeout.
Serial targeted checks compared the runnable Node program against the executable before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still missed three official cases despite its complete artifact; without per-case evaluator logs inside /pair, the exact ordinary logic defect is not identified.
Parallel child module defects or incomplete tests may exist, but the primary observed shortfall is missing assembly and entry delivery.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported explanation for the large quality and artifact gap; no discordant official pass/fail outcome exists in the current status records.
